Send a message to Plivo's AI assistant and stream the response.

The assistant uses Server-Sent Events: token text streams to stdout as it
arrives, live status appears on stderr and is overwritten in place, and the
final summary lands on stdout. Long flows (voice-debug can run 2–5 minutes)
work fine: the stream has no time limit unless you pass --timeout, which ends
it with exit 3. An answer the stream cuts off before its end also exits 3.
Ctrl-C cancels and exits 130; no auto-retry (debugger runs are not idempotent).

Use -i for an interactive chat that keeps context across follow-ups: each
turn replays the recent conversation as history (a one-shot ask sends none,
so the assistant can't see your previous questions). In -i, /reset starts a
fresh conversation, /help lists commands, and /exit or Ctrl-D leaves.

Pass --call-uuid for voice-debug context; --verbose to show the assistant's
tool calls; -o json or -o jsonl to emit each SSE event as one JSON line
(handy for scripts and AI agents). Either way the output is JSON Lines, one
object per line, not one JSON document: read it a line at a time. A stream
has no single result, so -o yaml, -o csv and --query are refused.

Usage:
  plivo ask [message] [flags]

Examples:
  plivo ask "What does Plivo SMS error code 30007 mean?"
  plivo ask -i
  plivo ask -i "Debug what happened on this call"
  plivo ask --call-uuid 21e68d29-... "Debug what happened on this call"
  plivo ask -o json "What's the rate for outbound voice to Brazil?"

Flags:
      --call-uuid string   voice-debug context: the call UUID the assistant should analyse
      --debug-stream       log every raw SSE frame to stderr (for debugging this CLI)
  -h, --help               help for ask
  -i, --interactive        interactive chat — keep a conversation with follow-ups (history sent each turn)
      --verbose            show the assistant's tool_call / tool_output events on stderr

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            preview requests and local changes without sending or writing anything
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json|jsonl|yaml|csv (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
      --query string       JMESPath filter on the JSON output, e.g. 'data.objects[].call_uuid' (implies -o json)
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --schema             describe the command (arguments, flags, output fields) instead of running it
      --show-secrets       show auth tokens and passwords in API responses instead of [REDACTED]
      --timeout duration   request timeout: seconds, or a duration such as 90s or 2m (default 30s)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
